home.text: Kinetic impact absorption grids combined with hyper-breathable matrix knit weaves. Forged for multi-directional velocity and structural speed performance. The most advanced propulsion system ever created.
"We don't build shoes. We engineer propulsion systems."— KINETIK Lab
For two years, our biomechanical engineers worked alongside Olympic athletes to deconstruct the physics of human movement. The result is a footwear system that doesn't just support — it amplifies.
Every curve, every material, every millimeter of the Quantum-Grid™ midsole is calibrated to convert kinetic energy into forward propulsion. This isn't a shoe. It's a performance multiplier.
12 months of biomechanical research in our propulsion lab
Proprietary geometric hollow cells that convert impact into forward propulsion with 94% energy return efficiency.
Hyper-breathable 3D-knitted upper that adapts to foot temperature while maintaining structural integrity.
Lightweight torsion plate that provides explosive toe-off and stabilizes each stride.
High-density adaptive knit system equipped with mechanical carbon energy-return plates.
Proprietary propulsion technology with 94% energy return.
Built to last. If it ever fails, we'll replace it.
Global delivery with full tracking and insurance.
Experience the difference. Return if not satisfied.
How does the Quantum-Grid™ midsole function?

Our proprietary Quantum-Grid™ features structural geometric hollow cells that deform on vertical impact, converting kinetic downward pressure directly into forward propulsion force energy with 94% efficiency.
All models run true to size according to international performance specifications. For wider foot profiles, we recommend ordering a half-size larger for optimal comfort.
Are the technical knit components waterproof?
The standard line maximizes airflow and ventilation while featuring a hydrophobic water-repellent coating that handles sudden weather changes or light rain conditions effortlessly.
We offer a 30-day performance trial. If the system doesn't meet your expectations, return it in original condition for a full refund. No questions asked.
Join thousands of athletes who've experienced the KINETIK difference. The Propulsion System is engineered to be the last performance shoe you'll ever need.
